issuing_body: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (農林水産省)
covered_actors: Farmers and agricultural organizations (農業関係者)
Agricultural extension advisors (農業普及指導員)
National and local governments, national R&D agencies, and independent administrative agencies (国、地方公共団体、研究開発法人、独立行政法人)
AI R&D commissioners and commissioned R&D entities/research institutions (ＡＩ研究開発委託者・ＡＩ研究開発者)
Agricultural AI product and service providers (製品・サービス提供者)
Third parties receiving agricultural AI data, models, or intellectual property (第三者)
implementation_notes: Non-binding ministerial contract guideline ('Know-how Utilization Edition') issued by MAFF in March 2020 for the agricultural sector (smart agriculture), building on METI's AI/Data Contract Guidelines (June 2018) and MAFF's Agricultural Data Contract Guidelines (December 2018). It provides model contract clauses, checklists, and term sheet templates covering R&D data/know-how provision, commissioned AI R&D (including publicly funded projects and Japanese Bayh-Dole Act considerations), AI product/service utilization, and third-party data/model transfers. It explicitly excludes statutory AI regulations outside contractual relationships and relies on private contract law, trade secret/limited provided data protections under the Unfair Competition Prevention Act, and personal data protections under Japan's APPI.
